benchmarks.label: Natural Questions
benchmarks.capability: Real queries with long, short, and null answers

benchmarks.label: SQuAD 2.0
benchmarks.capability: Passage extraction and adversarial no-answer cases

products.label: General fact assistant
products.detail: Answer varied user questions from a versioned corpus and abstain when support is missing.

products.label: Internal document reader
products.detail: Extract concise answers from supplied documents without inventing missing facts.

products.label: Closed-book trivia feature
products.detail: Return short stable facts while accepting documented aliases and measuring recall separately from freshness.

evidenceModes.label: Closed-book model memory
evidenceModes.detail: No documents are supplied at inference time; freshness and provenance remain outside the claim.
evidenceModes.claimLimit: This mode can support a frozen recall claim, not current or source-grounded answers.

evidenceModes.label: Retrieve from a frozen corpus
evidenceModes.detail: The system searches a versioned corpus, then gives the selected evidence to a reader.
evidenceModes.claimLimit: Report retrieval coverage and reader correctness separately.

evidenceModes.label: Read the supplied passage
evidenceModes.detail: Every question arrives with a bounded document selected outside the evaluated reader.
evidenceModes.claimLimit: This mode supports passage-reading claims, not broad recall or retrieval claims.
